name: AGARD/STA HB-2 hypersonic standard model (75 mm, approximated)
_notes: Geometry of the HB-2 standard model in AEDC-TDR-64-137, the report its anchors are read from (see the series sources in anchors.json). d = 75 mm; overall 4.900 d = 0.3675 m; base 1.600 d.

APPROXIMATIONS (kernel limits, to be revisited when nose bluntness lands): the 0.300 d spherical nose cap + 25 deg cone + 0.700 d fairing arc are modeled as a sharp cone ending at the true shoulder-cylinder tangency (0.818 d); the 4.000 d cylinder-flare fairing arc is split into cylinder to the fairing-flare tangency (3.553 d) + a conical flare to the base.
No fins - pure body aero (that is the point of this fixture).
DATASET REFERENCE AREA IS THE CYLINDER (d), NOT THE BASE: the kernel references the max diameter (1.6 d), so scored coefficients are multiplied by 2.56 (refAreaScale in anchors.json).
